    AI Overview
    The American Idol 2026 (Season 24) Top 20 features contestants including
    Makiyah, Jake Thistle, Genevieve Heyward, Daniel Stallworth, Kyndal Inskeep (Platinum Ticket), Kutter Bradley, Jesse Findling, Hannah Harper, Braden Rumfelt, and Brooks Rosser (Platinum Ticket). The group also includes Philmon Lee, Madison Moon, Ruby Rae, Lucas Leon, Chris Tungseth, Julián Kalel, Rae, Abayomi, and Keyla Richardson. 
    You can watch a recap of the Top 20 performing in Hawaii in this video:
    55s
    Inside Edition
    YouTube• Mar 14, 2025
    Key details from the Top 20 reveal: 
    • Performances & Voting: The Top 20 performed in Hawaii during episodes airing on March 16 and March 23, 2026, with voting to determine the Top 14.
    • Mentors & Judges: The Top 20 were mentored by Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley, with Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie serving as judges.
    • Platinum Tickets: Confirmed Platinum Ticket holders in the Top 20 include Brooks Rosser and Kyndal Inskeep.
    • Results: The results of the first public vote will be revealed on March 30, 2026, according to Yahoo and TV Insider.
    • Eliminated Contestants: Those cut from the Top 20 include Jacquie Lee, Bryant Thomas, Bella Emry, Sheldon Riley, Chloe Lauren, Brianna Yancey, Brenna Brigman, Michael Garner, Tianna Roberts, and Kiera Howell.
